Game Overview

In Builditekt, the core idea is straightforward: build, merge, and strategize in Builditekt. Stack blocks smartly to level up floors, unlock powerful boosts, and create the tallest skyline. With charming visuals and evolving challenges, this addictive puzzle game will test your planning skills as you navigate through an array of tricky decisions. How high can you go?
